اقتضيتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَضَيْتُمْ (iqtaḍaytum) /iq.ta.dˤaj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
# اُقْتُضِيتُمْ (uqtuḍītum) /uq.tu.dˤiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَضَى (iqtaḍā)
